title: BENEVOLENT DICTATORS? ON LLM AGENT BEHAVIOR IN DICTATOR GAMES

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the dictator game to evaluate whether LLM agents exhibit a bias toward altruism, fairness, or self-interest when deciding how to split an endowment with a powerless recipient.

Systematically varying system prompts, endowment amounts, and unit types (e.g., different currencies, liters of water, kilograms of rice) to measure how sensitive the models' distributive decisions are to contextual framing.
